Anchor is a lending protocol built on the Terra public blockchain. Anchor is a decentralized finance application that operates through smart contracts without intermediaries. Anchor offers depositors a savings yield on UST deposits.

AutoCake vault is a smart contract vault on the BNB Smart Chain. AutoCake vault automatically harvests and re-stakes CAKE rewards to compound returns for depositors. AutoCake vault is part of the PancakeSwap ecosystem.

Nexus Mutual is a decentralized insurance protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Nexus Mutual is a mutual organization whose members stake NXM tokens to back cover capacity. Nexus Mutual assesses claims through voting by NXM token holders.

AutoCake is a PancakeSwap product that automatically compounds CAKE rewards. AutoCake runs on the BNB Smart Chain.
